A living tradition · Guangzhou, China

广州早茶The Art of Yum Cha

一壶茶，几笼点心，一段慢下来的广州时光。

A pot of tea, baskets of dim sum, and time to enjoy the company of others.

DISCOVER THE STORY ↓
More than a breakfast

早茶，吃的是点心，
享受的是生活。

More than food.
A way of life.

在广州，“饮早茶”不只是吃早餐。人们坐在茶楼里，喝茶、分享点心、聊天，和家人朋友共度悠闲时光。

In Guangzhou, yum cha is more than breakfast. People gather at teahouses to drink tea, share dim sum, talk, and spend time with family and friends.
